Hi Nina — great to hear from you and thanks for the forecast. High level we can support the uplift and have a couple of paths depending on how sticky the increase looks:

Option A — Staged commit ladder (recommended)
- Months 1–3: 1.8M commit/mo (softly provisioned)
- Months 4+: 3.0M commit/mo with stepped discounts (see attached tier table)
- Soft-throttle threshold at 120% of committed capacity; burst pocket available for spikes (billed at burst rate).

Option B — Immediate uplift to dedicated reserved band
- Single new commit of 3.0M/mo for 12 months with deeper discount and SLA.

We can also add a temporary burst-credit allocation during rollout to avoid customer-impacting throttles in week 1. I'm attaching a proposal (PDF) with pricing bands and the suggested amendment language.

Next steps:
1) Tell me which option you prefer (ladder vs immediate commit).
2) If ladder, confirm the initial staged amounts and the target date for Oct 1 start.
3) I'll loop in legal/finance for the amendment and send a DocuSign link once we have agreement.

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync this week if helpful.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0187
